note: People → Exit & FnF. The clearance items an exit goes through and the reasons offered. SmartPRS 2 has them as a hard-coded field list; here a company adds an item (e.g. 'Laptop returned') by editing this file. The full-and-final settlement itself is computed on the settlement screen, from the last working day recorded here.
resignation_note: Owner, 22 Oct 2026: Submit / Revoke Resignation on the employee profile. A resignation is the exit record (reason Resignation) with status 'notice' while serving notice and 'revoked' if withdrawn; on its last_day (notice end) it becomes 'pending' and is listed in Exit & FnF. Notice = the employee's Notice Period (Days) field, else default_notice_days. notice_edit_roles may change the notice end date (administrator always).
